title: Support citations in Perplexity provider
body:
### Feature Description

Perplexity just announced that "Citations" are now enabled for everyone via the API: https://docs.perplexity.ai/changelog/changelog#citations-public-release-and-increased-default-rate-limits

They are returned alongside `choices` in the SSE response.

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This is an agent issue because it requests support for a new feature ("Citations") in the Perplexity LLM provider, which directly involves agent integration with an LLM provider and handling new model outputs. This aligns with the "Incompatibility with LLM providers" category.
